## Statement

Original wording (verbatim from the source):

```latex
$f(n,k)$ is the minimum number of edges of a graph on $n$ vertices in which every set of $k+2$ vertices induces a subgraph of maximum degree at least $k$. Determine $f(n,k)$.
```

Normalized:

Determine f(n,k).

## Known results

- The conjectured formula holds for k+2 <= n <= (3k+2)/2 and fails for all n >= 2k+1. *(Caleshu, math-conjectures, Conjectures/Erdos614 (Lean); computational; reproduced: True)*
